title: Add more chart types to stats page
body: Consider adding a line chart for time-series trend or category breakdown pie chart for a richer visualization experience.
rationale: The current implementation only has a bar chart for daily time spent. Additional chart types could provide more insights.

title: Add skeleton loading state for chart
body: The chart skeleton in StatsDashboard loading state should include a placeholder for the StudyActivityChart component.
rationale: Currently the loading skeleton doesn't account for the chart component, which could cause layout shift when switching from loading to data state.
